title: the Quiet Ways People Actually Change the World
content: The world may seem bleak to you at the moment but change can happen. It just starts with you! So check out this rundown of underrated ways to change the world! It's all about digging past excuses, letting good intentions turn into action (even in small ways), and finding meaningful, everyday paths to help others that don't require superpowers or massive sacrifice. Even better? There's a Part 2!
author: Brandon Blatcher
